title: Sunshine Law Request — Board packets for RSP & Associates (027-S-009-103) and Education Partners Practice & Policy contract items

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the The Missouri Sunshine Law, I hereby request the following records:

Under the Missouri Sunshine Law (RSMo Chapter 610), I request copies of the following public records. The date range for this request is August 1, 2026 through September 30, 2026, except for contract and payment records under item 3, which run from each contract's start through September 30, 2026.

In this request, a reference to any record includes that record under any title the District uses for it; where a title differs, I request the record that serves that function.

1. The complete agenda packet (including all attachments) for the September 23, 2026 Business / Tax Rate Hearing (Regular Business Meeting), specifically the contract action report / board action summary for agenda item 027-S-009-103: RSP & Associates, LLC — $83,100.
2. The complete agenda packet (including all attachments) for the August 26, 2026 Regular Business Meeting, specifically any contract action report / board action summary for Education Partners Practice & Policy — $102,000.

For each item, the request covers: scope of work / statement of work, funding source, contract term and dates, the approved amount, and the vote/approval record.

3. For each of the two contracts above, the executed contract (also called the agreement or professional services agreement), plus all amendments or change orders, and line-item invoices submitted and payments (also called payment records or disbursement records) made, through September 30, 2026.
4. If either contract resulted from a competitive solicitation, the solicitation document and any evaluation or scoring summary (also called a scoring matrix or evaluation summary).

Please provide records in electronic format where available, and produce records on a rolling basis as they are located and reviewed rather than holding all records until the full set is complete. If any portion is withheld or redacted, please cite the specific statutory exemption and release all reasonably segregable portions. If search or duplication fees are expected to exceed $50, please contact me with an estimate before processing; I do not authorize fees above $50 without my prior written approval.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Felipe Acano

title: FOIA Request — RFP #23.09 Strategic Plan Facilitator: proposals, evaluation scores and contract

communications.communication:
Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Under the Michigan Freedom of Information Act (MCL 15.231 et seq.), I request copies of the following records relating to Rochester Community Schools RFP #23.09, "Strategic Plan Facilitator" (2023; awarded to G&D Associates). The date range for this request is January 1, 2023 through September 30, 2026.

In this request, a reference to any record includes that record under any title the District uses for it; where a title differs, I request the record that serves that function.

1. The complete solicitation document for RFP #23.09, including all addenda and the evaluation criteria and weights.
2. The tabulation or summary of all proposals received (also called a bid abstract or proposal register), showing all proposers and all proposed prices, in its native spreadsheet format if maintained as one.
3. All evaluation and scoring records, including scoring sheets (also called evaluation forms, rating sheets, or scorecards), individual and consensus scores, rubrics, evaluator comments and worksheets (also called committee notes), and any interview or presentation scores. This includes evaluation records maintained in any e-procurement or agenda-management system the District uses.
4. All proposals submitted in response to RFP #23.09, including technical and cost proposals. If the volume is large, I prioritize: (a) the proposal of G&D Associates, and (b) the proposal of FourPoint Education Partners.
5. The executed contract (also called the agreement or professional services agreement) with G&D Associates, including scope of work, final price, term, and renewal options, plus all amendments, change orders, and extensions.
6. The board agenda item and supporting materials approving this award, including the funding source.
7. Line-item invoices submitted by, and payments (also called payment records or disbursement records) made to, G&D Associates under this contract, from the contract start through September 30, 2026.
8. The final deliverable(s) (also called work products or final reports) produced under this contract, including the adopted strategic plan document.

Please provide records in electronic format (searchable PDF or native files) where available, and produce records on a rolling basis as they are located and reviewed, beginning with the tabulation, scoring records, and executed contract, rather than holding all records until the full set is complete. If a responsive record is held by a third-party portal or vendor on the District's behalf, please produce it or identify where it is publicly posted. If any portion is withheld or redacted, please cite the specific statutory exemption and release all reasonably segregable portions. Pursuant to MCL 15.234, please provide an itemized fee estimate if fees will exceed $50, and contact me before processing if fees are expected to exceed $50; I do not authorize fees above $50 without my prior written approval.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Felipe Acano
